sources.text: Offline snapshots and SHA256: references/models/source-lock.json. BF16 mathematical/materialized causal GQA reference; no measured kernel or GPU performance claim. Weight tying follows config, despite duplicate serialized lm_head. HBM assumption: one declared read/write per buffer; no cache/reuse/materialized repeat_kv guarantee. Vector counts approximate norms 5/element, QK norm + RoPE 8/element, softmax 5/score, SiLU×up 6/element. FP32 vector work is separated from BF16 matrix work. No fused attention, rotary table/trig construction, allocator/runtime overhead or network model.
P6 adds authored fusion recipes only. Graph equations and all formula references are unchanged from decoder revision 1.
Revision 3 declares local batch and attention-head equations and preserves the global equations.

Contiguous prefill query partitions retain global causal positions. Each layer gathers the complete current K/V before a replicated append. The local attention rectangle retains all available key positions.

Decode uses one query per request and contiguous, equally sized KV slots. All ranks project the same token; the slot owner appends its K/V. FP32 max, denominator and weighted-value reductions merge the attention across ranks. The BF16 value matmul uses rounded unnormalized weights. This materialized reference scans the reserved slots and masks unused entries.
Request replicas use the same DCP equations on their local batch slices. Each replica merges its own requests across its KV ranks.
